People Ops: Heads-up 52 NYC all-hands next month (June 3). SF hub will be on reduced hours that week due to scheduled electrical maintenance. Read the notes for travel guidance and desk changes.
Lina (Onsite Coordinator): To confirm Conf rooms on 4th floor reserved for the all-hands watch party; if you're attending in-person in NYC, please use the travel form.
Raj: Quick Q If Im remote but in SF office that week, are meeting rooms open?
People Ops: Good point Rooms are available on the 3rd floor only (4th floor HVAC panels will be shut). Desk reservations for affected desks will be auto-switched to 3rd-floor hot desks.
Facilities Bot: Notice: building elevators 6 and 7 will be on maintenance 6/2-6/4 9ampm. Use elevator 2 near the lobby. Service elevator access for deliveries only.
Camille: Are we still providing the travel stipend for non-exec ICs? I have teammates flying in.
People Ops: Yes $200/night up to 2 nights for remote employees approved to attend. Contractors please check with managers. Submit receipts to Expensify with tag "nyc-allhands-2026".
Lina (Onsite Coordinator): Shuttle + hotel note: we have two shuttle windows Thu eve (9:00p) and Fri morning (7:00a). Hotels are booked through our travel portal; if you need early check-in, DM me and I'll request it.
Travel Ops Bot: Reminder: all flights must be booked through the travel portal for reimbursement. If you booked privately, request pre-approval.
Raj: Thanks one more Will there be a virtual watch option for APAC folks due to timezones?
People Ops: Yes Well livestream keynotes and record sessions. APAC-friendly social hours are scheduled later that day.
Facilities Bot: Security note: NYC badge readers will be rekeyed on 6/2 from 4pm6pm. Bring your government ID for revalidation if prompted.
Camille: Accessibility accommodation I need a riser near the stage for ASL interpreter. Who do I contact?
Lina (Onsite Coordinator): DM me and well prioritize it with venue ops. Were also arranging quiet rooms for pumping/meditation.
People Ops: RSVP link: https://forms.redwood.ai/nyc-allhands. Please RSVP by May 20 so we can finalize catering and shuttles.
Raj: Got it I'll update the team.
People Ops: Final note If your role requires you to be onsite and you cannot travel, speak to your manager ASAP for an exception. We'll post a logistics summary and calendar invites next week.
